summary: Grab Holdings filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing definitive agreements to acquire a 60% controlling equity interest in Neuroncredit Pte. Ltd. (Atome Financial), the digital financial services arm of Advance Intelligence Group, for $1.49 billion in cash. The target operates BNPL, cash loans, cards and digital lending across Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Indonesia and Thailand, serving 25 million cumulative users. No advisor, premium or close date was disclosed. Watch regulatory approvals across five Southeast Asian jurisdictions plus financing and minority-stake governance terms.
